observations: A large head fills most of the frame, tilted slightly left, with one eye area in warm red-pink tones and the other in blue-green, divided by a dark vertical line running from forehead to chin.

The lower third shows a row of white teeth outlined in heavy red and dark lines, with a visible dark gap above the tooth row suggesting the mouth is parted; loose scribbled lines in yellow, teal, magenta, and red extend outward from the head into the dark background.
The background is muted olive-brown with faint layered color shapes; the face carries flat areas of yellow-gold and blue-grey broken by dense overlapping line clusters at the eyes and cheeks.
reading: The face splits down the middle: warm amber and red on one side, cool blue-grey on the other. A row of teeth in the lower third, framed by thick red lines, reads as raw rather than decorative. Loose colored lines escape the head's outline into a dark ground, giving a feeling of pressure or overflow. The two eyes differ enough in color and mark density to suggest two states held in one form.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #282 and nnxyz nnotb #284 bracket this work. #282 also centers a head with parted teeth; #284 shifts to an animal form on a flat teal ground, showing the subject and emotional range the collector values.

connections.reason: Both works place a head with a parted mouth and visible tooth row at center, using dense overlapping colored lines at the eyes, but #282 sets its figure against a near-black ground with more isolated decorative elements, while #283 bleeds its lines into a warmer layered background.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly does the dark dividing line between the two halves of the face begin and end, and what happens to the line clusters on each side of it?
ambiguities: The faint layered shapes in the background may be additional drawn forms or underlying color blocks; image resolution does not resolve this clearly.

nnxyz nifty faces #20 shares the head-and-lines format but its dominant hot pink and yellow palette and framed border are distinct enough that no strong formal connection to #283 is supported beyond the general face subject.
